title: Warp, a startup using AI to automate payroll compliance and employee management, raised a $60M Series B led by Battery, bringing its total funding to $85M (Lucinda Shen/Axios)
summary: Lucinda Shen / Axios: Warp, a startup using AI to automate payroll compliance and employee management, raised a $60M Series B led by Battery, bringing its total funding to $85M — Warp, a startup using AI to automate payroll compliance and employee management, raised $60 million in Series B funding, CEO Ayush Sharma tells Axios exclusively.
